title: A site redirect to its own hostname on a stale port or scheme (Joomla live_site from the old :8080 stand) lands on the address the visitor used, not on a refused connection
steps: S1: Start a throwaway PostgreSQL (for example: docker run -d --rm --name reg192-pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=t -p 127.0.0.1:55432:5432 postgres:16-alpine) and wait until pg_isready answers.
S2: From the TCH checkout run: TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:t@127.0.0.1:55432/postgres node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/bar.test.mjs
S3: Read the exit code, the `# pass`, `# fail`, `# skipped` and `# cancelled` lines and the tests named below, then stop the PostgreSQL container.

S4: Run the REG-192 script; it additionally checks signed public origins, managed frame-policy reconciliation across all three CMS, authenticated preview ordering, and shared Apache/EmDash policy generation.
expect: S2 exits 0 with 0 failures, 0 skipped, 0 cancelled.

"a redirect to the site's OWN hostname on a stale port or scheme lands on the address the visitor used" passes: a site answering `Location: http://stale.tracy.test:8080/` or `https://stale.tracy.test/en/?x=1` to a visitor on `http://stale.tracy.test:51710` is reframed to `http://stale.tracy.test:51710/` and `http://stale.tracy.test:51710/en/?x=1`.
'a redirect to a THIRD party is left exactly as the site wrote it' still passes: `https://checkout.stripe.com/x` is not touched.

'a redirect naming the INTERNAL container is reframed onto the address the visitor used', both EmDash redirect tests and 'a local CMS redirect that adds a port to its Docker hostname stays on the public site' still pass.

S4: Changing origin A to B at arbitrary ports updates managed policy exactly once on WordPress, Joomla and EmDash; content/mail/publish survive, custom and none remain unchanged, invalid or unsigned calls cannot write, and failed reconciliation returns a framable message before upstream.

selectors.door: `reframeLocation` in apps/tracy-web/src/bar/site-proxy.js, reached through the site hostname route of bar/route.js
selectors.header: the `location` response header a site hostname answers

evidence: 01/10/2026: on a local stand a Joomla site born while TRACY_ORIGIN was http://tracy.test:8080 (before f3367844b2, 11/09) kept `$live_site = 'http://tracy-ai-8836f920.tracy.test:8080'`; pages rendered, but signing in or out inside the Browser tab showed 'tracy-ai-8836f920.tracy.test refused to connect'. Reproduced 05/10 on vincent-testing1 with live_site set to :8080: GET /index.php?option=com_users&view=login answered 301 to :8080 and the Browser tab showed the same error; after the fix the same GET and a sign-in POST (303) stay on :51710.
fence: Mechanism only: the proxy runs under node --test with a stub upstream fetch and a real PostgreSQL. Not covered: a real Joomla or WordPress, a browser, absolute links the site prints INSIDE its HTML (canonical, og:url), which still name the stale address until its live_site / WP_HOME is corrected. Managed frame policy is also covered with temporary configuration files and fake Docker calls on all three CMS; preview ordering and signed host routes use real Hono requests. The separate stand iframe receipt is manual browser evidence, not part of this automated case.
